units: path state, unique member subset, image endpoint; never independent people
mask: D10 uses exactly the saved B8L2 nonmissing mask; original holds and primary_comparison_eligible still apply
numeric: B8L2_numeric and D10_numeric include diagnostics; OOS never quality eligible
missing: missing components, deferred k2, insufficient nodes or connection remain missing; no zero fill or interpolation
endpoints: automatic and assisted separate; same_input_as_current_automatic required for paired endpoints
geometry: saved states unchanged; no fusion rerun or additional measurement
stability: same_k_geometry_and_legacy_scores.csv is preserved geometry/old score evidence, not recalculated D10 stability
reference: exact frozen target points/floors checked against current reference catalog; never highest-score selection
current_team_target_relation: current shared routing of members relative to fixed fusion reference; all_declared_target / contains_other_target / pending; never automatically promotes quality eligibility
comparison_eligibility_version: prior usage_v2 frozen common mask; current target changes attached separately
